title: The Largest Desert on Earth Is Made of Ice
description: Discover why the coldest place on Earth is actually its largest and driest desert.
instagram_caption: Think deserts are only hot and sandy? Think again. ❄️ Earth's largest desert is actually frozen solid—and the science behind it will blow your mind! #geography #sciencefacts #nature #wondersofnature

segments.narration: Forget everything you know about scorching sand dunes. The largest desert on Earth is actually a frozen wasteland of solid ice.
Science defines a desert by its lack of moisture, not temperature. Here, the freezing air is too dry to hold the vapor needed for rain or snow.
Yet, this hyper-dry wilderness holds ninety percent of the world’s fresh water, locked away in colossal ice sheets built up over millions of years.
So when you look at this frozen continent, you are looking at the quietest, coldest, and most beautiful desert on Earth.
